review_description: Thanks Yorke Solar, stress free, easy to deal with and quality job.

Sales and quoting services went well and included a personal visit to our property. For a property in a rural location, this was an advantage in going with a mid North-based provider.Installation went well. Yorke Solar committed to the installation date a few weeks ahead and turned up on time and did a good job and tidied up after them. They took time to explain everything to us and assisted us in getting the relevant app working. Their phone services were also excellent with their staff getting back to us very promptly each time we have a query.One hitch for us was that our place does not have wifi or broadband so Yorke Solar explained the option of a mobile modem to overcome this new SA government requirement.
The customer service was excellent. The quality of the system is top class. 4 guys installed my 10kw system in 1/2 day.Its already saving me money.
Great customer service and communication throughout the installation process. All our questions were answered quickly by an informed team.

Yorke solar were very quick to send a very detailed quote and also rang to discuss other options. The price was the lowest and the panels and inverter were also on the list recommended. The warranties were also goodThe installers were here on the day and were friendly and very efficient. The materials used were also great quality.Everything was organised with power network and installation of smart meter and it was all turned on only a month after ordering. Very happy with everything so far and enjoy the AGL ap which shows everything. I would certainly recommend this company.
Quoting was good but basic. Upgraded system with your information on web site.Installation was all of above.Organised all paperwork and provided all certificates associated with grid connection.
All good they organised everything.Price was good service great

Very easy & extremely help full. Im not very good with computers and Letitia helped me through the whole process. The install done very fast with the team swapping their days off to get it done before Christmas.                                      Customer service went out of their way to help us as we had to wait on settlement on the house. Yes they organised everything I can not speak highly enough of the company, especially Letitia who handled everything.

Their service was prompt and straight forward.We imagined that having a system installed on Kangaroo Island might create some problems but the installation happened within a week or so and was very neat and tidy with no rubbish left behind.Grid connection happened simultaneously.Follow up was thorough and we had the smart controller installed a couple of weeks later.
Called on Monday, Installed on Thursday!Answered all questions and Clean, Tidy Installation.

Yorke Solar were great. They rang and quoted the same day I was given their information. Very professional team and customer service great. Installed in one day. So happy with them I am getting another solar job done
Easy to communicate with, visited my property to provide advice, friendly and polite.
Great customer service. Nothing was too much trouble.Installation was slick, clean and professional. Have already recommemded Yorke Solar to friends wanting solar.
Met all installation expectations and very good to deal with, including follow up customer service with Network provider  and energy retailer
There was already a solar system in place. YP SOLAR  removed the older system and installed a new system.They took control of all the process.
Fast  quote and installationAttentive and responsive installer, good result all round
